title: 29.x: Power BI autodeployment UX fixes: clearing records should affect only the selected + reorganizing actions
summary: Power BI auto-deployment clearing now affects only the selected record instead of all records, and action ordering on the deployment page has been reorganized.
key_points: Clearing deployment records removes only the selected record from Business Central state, not all records
Actions on the Power BI Report Deployments page have been reorganized per PM request
Changes apply to the Power BI Subscribers codeunit, deployment-related tables, and the deployments page
Test coverage added for the deployment functionality
Fix resolves Azure DevOps issue AB#659760
